output.summary: The 98% figure is a product of the TMS definition, which lets dispatchers reset promised dates. Revisions rose about 5x from March 2026 at Northgate and Riverside, and from July at Pell Junction, matching each center's bonus eligibility date. Customer-requested and weather revisions did not rise, and the reason-code shift is toward capacity. Lateness complaints rose before the portal launched, and RouteWise went live after or without matching changes in the on-time figure. Brightwell's own receiving data shows 81% on time against 87% a year earlier. Campaign and the 99% bonus tier are harmful. Recompute against original dates first. Driver shortage is plausible but unconfirmed, so the $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
